G3000.b:
⟪λατρεύω⟫
(< λάτρις, a hired servant), [in LXX (always, as λατρεία, of the service of God or of heathen divinities) chiefly for ⁨עבד⁩, ⟦Exodus 3:12|Ex 3:12⟧, al.; in Da LXX TH (⟦Daniel 3:12|3:12⟧, al.) for ⁨פְּלַח⁩;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to work for hire⟫.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to serve⟫; in cl., also of divine service, ⟪to serve⟫, ⟪worship⟫, and so always in NT: c. dat. pers., τ. θεῷ, ⟦Matthew 4:10|Mt 4:10⟧, ⟦Luke 4:8|Lk 4:8⟧(LXX), ⟦Acts 7:7|Ac 7:7⟧ ⟦Acts 24:14|24:14⟧ ⟦Acts 27:23|27:23⟧, ⟦Hebrews 9:14|He 9:14⟧, ⟦Revelation 7:15|Re 7:15⟧ ⟦Revelation 22:3|22:3⟧; of idol worship (cf. ⟦Exodus 20:5|Ex 20:5⟧, ⟦Ezekiel 20:32|Ez 20:32⟧), ⟦Acts 7:42|Ac 7:42⟧, ⟦Romans 1:25|Ro 1:25⟧; τ. θεῷ ἐν τ. πνεύματί μου, ⟦Romans 1:9|Ro 1:9⟧; id. ἐν καθαρᾷ συνειδήσει, ⟦2 Timothy 1:3|II Ti 1:3⟧; μετ’ εὐλαβείας κ. δέους, ⟦Hebrews 12:28|He 12:28⟧; ἐν ὁσιότητι κ. δικαιοσύνῃ, ⟦Luke 1:74|Lk 1:74⟧; (without θεῷ) νηστείαις κ. δεήσεσι, ⟦Luke 2:37|Lk 2:37⟧; πνεύματι θεοῦ, ⟦Philippians 3:3|Phl 3:3⟧; absol., ⟦Acts 26:7|Ac 26:7⟧; ὁ λατρεύων, ⟪the worshipper⟫, ⟦Hebrews 9:9|He 9:9⟧ ⟦Hebrews 10:2|10:2⟧; of ministerial service, c. dat. rei, ⟦Hebrews 8:5|He 8:5⟧ ⟦Hebrews 13:10|13:10⟧.†
SYN.: λειτουργέω, q.v.

G3001.b:
⟪λάχανον⟫, -ου, τό
(λαχαίνω, to dig), [in LXX: ⟦Genesis 9:3|Ge 9:3⟧, ⟦1 Kings 21:2|III Ki 20 (21):2⟧, ⟦Psalms 37:2|Ps 36 (37):2⟧, ⟦Proverbs 15:17|Pr 15:17⟧ (⁨יֶרֶק⁩, ⁨יָרָק⁩)*;] ⟪a garden herb⟫, ⟪vegetable⟫: ⟦Luke 11:42|Lk 11:42⟧; usually in pl., ⟦Matthew 13:32|Mt 13:32⟧, ⟦Mark 4:32|Mk 4:32⟧, ⟦Romans 14:2|Ro 14:2⟧.†
SYN.: βοτάνη, q.v.

G3002.b:
⟪λεββαῖος⟫, -ου, ὁ
(on the derivation, v. Dalman, Words, 50; Swete, ⟦Mark 3:18|Mk. 3:18⟧), ⟪Lebbæus⟫: ⟦Matthew 10:3|Mt 10:3⟧, ⟦Mark 3:18|Mk 3:18⟧ (WH, mg.; Θαδδαῖος, q.v., Rec., WH, txt., RV, cf. WH, App., 11, 24. In ⟦Luke 6:15|Lk 6:15⟧, ⟦Acts 1:13|Ac 1:13⟧, he is called Σίμων ὁ Ζηλωτής.)†

Commentaries on the Gospel according to St. Mark (Third Edition, 1909) and the Apocalypse of St. John, by H. B. Swete. Macmillan, 1906
The N.T. in the original Greek, by B. F. Westcott and F. J. A. Hort. Vol. II, Introduction and Appendix. Macmillan, 1881

G3004.b:
⟪λέγω⟫,
[in LXX very freq., chiefly for ⁨אמר⁩; λέγει for ⁨נְאֻם⁩, ⟦Genesis 22:16|Ge 22:16⟧, al.;]
⟪1.⟫ in Hom., ⟪to pick out⟫, ⟪gather⟫, ⟪reckon⟫, ⟪recount⟫.
⟪2.⟫ In Hdt. and Att., ⟪to say⟫, ⟪speak⟫, ⟪affirm⟫, ⟪declare⟫: absol., ⟦Acts 13:15|Ac 13:15⟧ ⟦Acts 24:10|24:10⟧; seq. orat. dir., ⟦Matthew 9:34|Mt 9:34⟧, ⟦Mark 3:11|Mk 3:11⟧, ⟦John 1:29|Jo 1:29⟧, al.; seq. ὅτι recit., ⟦Mark 3:21|Mk 3:21⟧, ⟦Luke 1:24|Lk 1:24⟧, ⟦John 6:14|Jo 6:14⟧, al.; acc. et. inf., ⟦Luke 11:18|Lk 11:18⟧, ⟦John 12:29|Jo 12:29⟧, al.; after another verb of speaking, προσφωνεῖν κ. λέγειν, ⟦Matthew 11:17|Mt 11:17⟧, al.; ἀπεκρίθη (ἐλάλησεν) λέγων (καὶ λέγει; Dalman, Words, 24 ff.), ⟦Matthew 25:9|Mt 25:9⟧, ⟦Mark 3:33|Mk 3:33⟧, ⟦Mark 7:28|7:28⟧, ⟦Luke 24:6|Lk 24:6⟧, ⟦Luke 24:7|7⟧, al.; of unspoken thought, λ. ἐν ἑαυτῷ, ⟦Matthew 3:9|Mt 3:9⟧, ⟦Luke 3:8|Lk 3:8⟧, al.; of writing, ⟦2 Corinthians 8:8|II Co 8:8⟧, ⟦Philippians 4:11|Phl 4:11⟧, al.; λέγει ἡ γραφή, ⟦Romans 4:3|Ro 4:3⟧, ⟦James 2:23|Ja 2:23⟧, al.; c. acc. rei, ⟦Luke 8:8|Lk 8:8⟧ ⟦Luke 9:33|9:33⟧, ⟦John 5:34|Jo 5:34⟧, al.; σὺ λέγεις (a non-committal phrase; Swete, Mk., 359, 369 f.), ⟦Matthew 27:11|Mt 27:11⟧, ⟦Mark 15:2|Mk 15:2⟧, ⟦Luke 23:3|Lk 23:3⟧, ⟦John 18:37|Jo 18:37⟧; c. dat. pers., seq. orat. dir., ⟦Matthew 8:20|Mt 8:20⟧, ⟦Mark 2:17|Mk 2:17⟧, al. mult.; id. seq. ὅτι, ⟦Matthew 3:9|Mt 3:9⟧, al.; c. prep., πρός, μετά, περί, etc., ⟦Mark 4:41|Mk 4:41⟧, ⟦John 11:56|Jo 11:56⟧, ⟦Hebrews 9:5|He 9:5⟧, al.; ⟪to mean⟫ (cl.), ⟦Mark 14:71|Mk 14:71⟧, ⟦John 6:71|Jo 6:71⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 10:29|I Co 10:29⟧, al.; ⟪to call⟫, ⟪name⟫, ⟦Mark 10:18|Mk 10:18⟧; pass., ⟦Matthew 9:9|Mt 9:9⟧, ⟦Mark 15:7|Mk 15:7⟧, al (cf. ἀντι-, δια- (-μαι), προ-, συλ-λέγω).
SYN.: λαλέω, which refers to the utterance, as λέγω to the meaning of what is said, its correspondence with thought (Tr., Syn., Ixxvi; Thayer, s.v. λαλέω).
a: The Words of Jesus, by G. Dalman. English Edition. T. & T. Clark, 1902
Commentaries on the Gospel according to St. Mark (Third Edition, 1909) and the Apocalypse of St. John, by H. B. Swete. Macmillan, 1906
Synonyms of the N. T. , by R. C. Trench. Ninth Edition. Macmillan, 1880

G3005.b:
⟪λεῖμμα⟫ (WH, λίμμα, v. their App., 154), -τος, τό
(< λείπω), [in LXX: ⟦2 Kings 19:4|IV Ki 19:4⟧ A (⁨שְׁאֵרִית⁩)*;] ⟪a remnant⟫: ⟦Romans 11:5|Ro 11:5⟧.†

G3006.b:
⟪λεῖος⟫, -εία, -εῖον,
[in LXX: ⟦Genesis 27:11|Ge 27:11⟧, ⟦1 Samuel 17:40|I Ki 17:40⟧ R (⁨חָלָק⁩, ⁨חַלּוּק⁩); ὁδὸς λ., ⟦Isaiah 40:4|Is 40:4⟧ Α (⁨בִּקְעָה⁩); ⟦Proverbs 2:20|Pr 2:20⟧ ⟦Proverbs 12:13|12:13⟧ ⟦Proverbs 26:23|26:23⟧*;] ⟪smooth⟫: opp. to τραχύς, ⟦Luke 3:5|Lk 3:5⟧(LXX).†

G3007.b:
⟪λείπω⟫,
[in LXX: ⟦Job 4:11|Jb 4:11⟧, ⟦Proverbs 19:1|Pr 19:1⟧ (⟦Proverbs 19:4|4⟧) (⁨פּרד⁩), al.;]
⟪1.⟫ trans., ⟪to leave⟫, ⟪leave behind⟫; pass., ⟪to be left behind⟫, ⟪to lack⟫ seq. prep. (as more usual in cl.), ἐν, ⟦James 1:4|Ja 1:4⟧; c. gen. rei, ⟦James 1:5|Ja 1:5⟧ ⟦James 2:15|2:15⟧.
⟪2.⟫ Intrans., ⟪to be gone⟫, ⟪to be wanting⟫: c. dat. pers., ⟦Luke 18:22|Lk 18:22⟧, ⟦Titus 3:13|Tit 3:13⟧; τὰ λείποντα, ⟦Titus 1:5|Tit 1:5⟧ (cf. ἀπο-, δια-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, κατα-, ἐν-κατα-, περι-, ὑπο-λείπω).†

G3008.b:
⟪λειτουργέω⟫, -ῶ
(< λειτουργός), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨שׁרת⁩ pi., also for ⁨עבד⁩, ⁨צבא⁩, etc.;]
⟪1.⟫ in cl., at Athens, ⟪to supply public offices at one's own cost⟫, ⟪render public service to the State⟫, hence, generally,
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to serve the State⟫, ⟪do a service⟫, ⟪serve⟫ (of service to the Gods, Diod., i, 21): of the official service of priests and Levites (⟦Exodus 29:30|Ex 29:30⟧, ⟦Numbers 16:9|Nu 16:9⟧, Si 4:14, I Mac 10:42, al.; cf. Deiss., BS, 140 f.), ⟦Hebrews 10:11|He 10:11⟧; of Christians: c. dat. pers. seq. ἐν, ⟦Romans 15:27|Ro 15:27⟧ (cf. Si 10:25); τ. κυρίῳ, ⟦Acts 13:2|Ac 13:2⟧.†
SYN.: λατρεύω (q.v.), prop., to serve for hire, LXX (as sometimes in cl.), always of service to the deity on the part of both priests and people (⟦Exodus 4:3|Ex 4:3⟧, ⟦Deuteronomy 10:12|De 10:12⟧, and similarly in NT). λειτουργέω "is the fulfilment of an office: it has a definite representative character, and corresponds with a function to be discharged". It is therefore used of serving in an office or ministry: in LXX always of priests and Levites, in NT, with its cognates (⟦Romans 13:6|Ro 13:6⟧ ⟦Romans 15:27|15:27⟧, are not really exceptions), of services rendered either to God or man by apostles, prophets, teachers, and other officers of the church (cf. Tr., Syn., § xxxv; ICC on ⟦Romans 1:9|Ro 1:9⟧; Westc., He., 232 ff.).
a: Bible Studies, by G. A. Deissmann. Second English Edition, including Bibelstudien and Neue Bibelstudien, tr. by A. Grieve. T. & T. Clark, 1909
Synonyms of the N. T. , by R. C. Trench. Ninth Edition. Macmillan, 1880
Commentaries on the Gospel according to St. John, by B. F. Westcott, 2 Vols., Murray, 1908; the Epistle to the Ephesians, Macmiilan, 1906; the Epistles of St. John, Third Edition, Macmillan, 1892

G3009.b:
⟪λειτουργία⟫, -ας, ἡ
(< λειτουργέω), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨עֲבֹדָה⁩, ⟦Numbers 4:24|Nu 4:24⟧, ⟦1 Chronicles 9:13|I Ch 9:13⟧, al.;]
⟪1.⟫ in cl. (chiefly of Athens), ⟪the discharge of a public office at one's own expense⟫ (v. LS, s.v.), hence,
⟪2.⟫ ⟪a service⟫, ⟪ministry⟫; in π. (Deiss., BS, 140 f.) and in LXX (though here also of secular service, ⟦1 Kings 1:4|III Ki 1:4⟧, al.), of religious service or ministration; and so in NT: of priestly ministrations, ⟦Luke 1:23|Lk 1:23⟧, ⟦Hebrews 8:6|He 8:6⟧ ⟦Hebrews 9:21|9:21⟧; fig., θυσία καὶ λ. τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν, ⟦Philippians 2:17|Phl 2:17⟧; of Christian beneficence, ⟦2 Corinthians 9:12|II Co 9:12⟧, ⟦Philippians 2:30|Phl 2:30⟧.†
a: Bible Studies, by G. A. Deissmann. Second English Edition, including Bibelstudien and Neue Bibelstudien, tr. by A. Grieve. T. & T. Clark, 1909
A Greek-English Lexicon, by H. G. Liddell and R. Scott. Seventh Edition. Harper, 1889

G3010.b:
† ⟪λειτουργικός⟫, -ή, -όν,
[in LXX for ⁨עֲבֹדָה⁩, ⁨שָׁרֵת⁩; ἔργα, ⟦Numbers 7:5|Nu 7:5⟧; στολαί, ⟦Exodus 31:9|Ex 31:9⟧ (⟦Exodus 31:10|10⟧) ⟦Exodus 39:13|39:13⟧ (⟦Exodus 39:1|1⟧); σκευή, ⟦Numbers 4:12|Nu 4:12⟧, ⟦Numbers 4:26|26⟧, ⟦2 Chronicles 24:14|II Ch 24:14⟧*;] ⟪of⟫ or ⟪for service⟫, ⟪ministering⟫: πνεύματα, ⟦Hebrews 1:14|He 1:14⟧.†

G3011.b:
⟪λειτουργός⟫, -οῦ, ὁ
(< λιός, ἔργον), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨מְשָׁרֵת⁩, ⟦Joshua 1:1|Jos 1:1⟧ A, ⟦1 Kings 10:5|III Ki 10:5⟧, ⟦Psalms 103:21|Ps 102 (103):21⟧, Si 7:30, al.;]
⟪1.⟫ in cl., ⟪one who discharges a public office at his own expense⟫, then, generally,
⟪2.⟫ ⟪a public servant⟫, ⟪a minister⟫, ⟪servant⟫: τ. ἁγίων λ., ⟦Hebrews 8:2|He 8:2⟧ (cf. ⟦Nehemiah 10:39|Ne 10:39⟧, Si 7:30); Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ⟦Romans 15:16|Ro 15:16⟧; pl., τ. θεοῦ, ⟦Romans 13:6|Ro 13:6⟧, ⟦Hebrews 1:7|He 1:7⟧(LXX); λ. ὑμῶν τ. χρείας μου, ⟦Philippians 2:25|Phl 2:25⟧.†
SYN.: v.s. διάκονος, λειτουργέω.

G3013.b:
⟪λεπίς⟫, -ίδος, ἡ
(< λέπω, to peel) [in LXX chiefly for ⁨קַשְׂקֶשֶׂת⁩;] ⟪a scale⟫: ⟦Acts 9:18|Ac 9:18⟧.†

G3015.b:
⟪λεπρός⟫, -ά, -όν

G3018.b:

G3021.b:
⟪λευκαίνω⟫
(< λευκός), [in LXX: ⟦Psalms 51:7|Ps 50 (51):7⟧, ⟦Isaiah 1:18|Is 1:18⟧ (⁨לבן⁩ hi.), etc.;] ⟪to whiten⟫, ⟪make white⟫: c. acc. rei, ⟦Mark 9:3|Mk 9:3⟧, ⟦Revelation 7:14|Re 7:14⟧.†

⟪1.⟫ ⟪bright⟫, ⟪brilliant⟫: of clothing, ⟦Matthew 17:2|Mt 17:2⟧, ⟦Mark 9:3|Mk 9:3⟧ ⟦Mark 16:5|16:5⟧, ⟦Luke 9:29|Lk 9:29⟧, ⟦Acts 1:10|Ac 1:10⟧, ⟦Revelation 3:5|Re 3:5⟧ ⟦Revelation 4:4|4:4⟧ ⟦Revelation 6:11|6:11⟧ ⟦Revelation 7:9|7:9⟧, ⟦Revelation 7:13|13⟧ ⟦Revelation 19:14|19:14⟧ (cf. ⟦Ecclesiastes 9:8|Ec 9:8⟧); ὡς χιών, ⟦Matthew 28:3|Mt 28:3⟧; ἐν λ. G3028.b:

Kennedy, Sources, 40), [in LXX for ⁨מְנוֹרָה⁩ (⟦Exodus 25:31|Ex 25:31⟧ ⟦Exodus 40:4|40:4⟧, al.);] ⟪a lampstand⟫: ⟦Matthew 5:15|Mt 5:15⟧, ⟦Mark 4:21|Mk 4:21⟧, ⟦Luke 8:16|Lk 8:16⟧ ⟦Luke 11:33|11:33⟧; of that in the Tabernacle, ⟦Hebrews 9:2|He 9:2⟧; metaph., of the two witnesses, ⟦Revelation 11:4|Re 11:4⟧; of the seven churches of Asia, ⟦Revelation 1:12|Re 1:12⟧, ⟦Revelation 1:13|13⟧, ⟦Revelation 1:20|20⟧ ⟦Revelation 2:1|2:1⟧; of the removal of a church from its position, κινεῖν τ. λυχνίαν κ.τ.λ., ⟦Revelation 2:5|Re 2:5⟧.†

[in LXX for ⁨אַשָּׁף⁩, ⟦Daniel 2:2|Da LXX TH 2:2⟧, ⟦Daniel 2:10|10⟧, al. (cf. ⁨רַב־מָג⁩ chief magian, ⟦Jeremiah 39:3|Je 39:3⟧, ⟦Jeremiah 39:13|13⟧);]

⟪3.⟫ ⟪a wizard⟫, ⟪sorcerer⟫: ⟦Acts 13:6|Ac 13:6⟧, ⟦Acts 13:8|8⟧ (cf. Wi 17:7, ⟦Acts 8:9|Ac 8:9⟧, ⟦Acts 8:11|11⟧).†
